title: Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist
description:
US Salary: $175,000 - $215,000
About Us
Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra 's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.
About the Role
We are seeking a Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist to build Bonterra 's first dedicated pricing function. This is a senior individual-contributor role (no direct reports at launch), and you'll own the discipline end to end: willingness-to-pay research, value metric design, packaging architecture, and AI pricing methodologies across a SaaS product portfolio and a fast-growing AI product line.
You won't simply be inheriting a pre-built function to maintain or administrate. You're coming in to assess what's already there, decide what to keep and what to rebuild, then stand up the strategy and cadence from the ground up. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Bonterra to get a baseline of current SaaS product and AI financial metrics, assess the Pricing Committee and governance structure, and align our pricing strategy to the annual operating plan goals for 2027 and beyond.
You'll be the first hire into a new pricing function, reporting directly to the CPO, who has direct experience with pricing strategy from PwC, startups, and PE software companies. You won't be evangelizing pricing discipline into a skeptical org, and you won't be handed a playbook to simply execute either. You're stepping into an executive room that's already bought into the importance of this work, and you'll have full latitude to shape what comes next. You own the strategy, the governance model, and the cadence going forward, not just the execution of decisions someone else already made. You will have investments in the proper tools to succeed.
In this role, you will:

• Own willingness-to-pay research and value metric design for Bonterra Que (our AI-powered product suite that turns a customer's own fragmented data into actionable insights and recommendations, and a fast-growing part of our business) and for the broader product portfolio (Case Management, Fundraising Solutions, Fundraising Experiences, Corporate Social Responsibility, and Payments).

• Build the pricing research methodology at Bonterra : conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp, and value-based pricing frameworks applied to a real, in-flight portfolio, not a greenfield exercise. We will then turn the findings into actionable decisions for our products.

• Design packaging architecture including tier definitions, feature gating, bundle logic for current products as well as new Que AI skills coming to market.

• Build and maintain competitive pricing intelligence against key competitors in the market, while also pulling from new approaches to AI pricing from high growth AI companies out of market.

• Deliver the first annual pricing benchmark study for Bonterra , based on internal performance against a SaaS peer set, built to be board-ready.

• Provide a pricing input on every new product investment proposal before it's approved, making revenue forecast projections a scored dimension within our business case structure.

• Partner directly with the CPO on Pricing Committee strategic reviews and represent pricing methodology at a senior level across Product, Finance, and Commercial.

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

Since being acquired by ClickHouse, with access to ClickHouse's broader GTM resources, Langfuse now has a growing enterprise motion and a large self-hosted user base.

This role exists to give Langfuse a clear, accurate narrative that is easier to understand and adopt.

 

HOW THE ROLE WORKS

This role is for a product marketer who likes technical depth. A technical background is a strong plus, you should be technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.

You'll become a true power user of Langfuse, and gain a front-row seat into how the best AI teams build production applications.

You should expect close working relationships with both Langfuse teams and ClickHouse’s product marketing, sales and regional GTM teams.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Substantial experience in product marketing, product, or a technical role, including time spent on industry or vertical marketing.

- Past track record of crafting compelling messaging, positioning, and value propositions that resonate with developers, technical buyers, AI teams, enterprise stakeholders, and other highly technical audiences.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

- You have a technical background and an analytical mindset with the capacity to leverage data and metrics to measure performance in open-source PLG funnels and inform decision-making.

- Cross-functional collaborator comfortable working with stakeholders across functions and levels.

- A strong plus if you have a background in dev tools, open source, observability, or data/cloud infra. and/or if you have an existing public content or writing presence.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build messaging, positioning, and value props that work for developers, technical buyers, and enterprise stakeholders alike

- Own the category narrative (LLM observability, evals, prompt management, agent observability, self-hosting)

- Create sales enablement and marketing collateral and assets, including website content, blogs, webinars and presentations, launch narratives, and more

- Conduct competitive analysis to understand market trends, identify opportunities, and inform product and marketing strategies

- Evaluate and iterate on strategies with metrics and feedback from stakeholders to track efficacy, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven recommendations

- Lead product and feature launches, and spend time with users, customers, prospects, sales, support, and community members.

 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

• 5 years experience in ERP

• Strong programming skills in C# and SQL

• Proven experience as an Epicor Developer, Consultant, or Analyst with a focus on customization and technical tools.

• Excellent analytical and communication skills to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.

title: Contract - Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Quantum computing holds the promise of humanity’s mastery over the natural world, but only if we can build a real quantum computer. PsiQuantum is on a mission to build the first real, useful quantum computers, capable of delivering the world-changing applications that the technology has long promised. We know that means we will need to build a system with roughly 1 million qubits that supports fault tolerant error correction within a scalable architecture, and a data center footprint.

By harnessing the laws of quantum physics, quantum computers can provide exponential performance increases over today’s most powerful supercomputers, offering the potential for extraordinary advances across a broad range of industries including climate, energy, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials design, and many more.

PsiQuantum has determined the fastest path to delivering a useful quantum computer, years earlier than the rest of the industry. Our architecture is based on silicon photonics which gives us the ability to produce our components at Tier-1 semiconductor fabs such as GlobalFoundries where we leverage high-volume semiconductor manufacturing processes, the same processes that are already producing billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics applications. We also benefit from the quantum mechanics reality that photons don’t feel heat or electromagnetic interference, allowing us to take advantage of existing cryogenic cooling systems and industry standard fiber connectivity.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced two government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first Quantum Data Centers and utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia and Chicago, Illinois. Both projects are backed by nations that understand quantum computing’s potential impact and the need to scale this technology to unlock that potential. And we won’t just be building the hardware, but also the fault tolerant quantum applications that will provide industry-transforming results.

Quantum computing is not just an evolution of the decades-old advancement in compute power. It provides the key to mastering our future, not merely discovering it. The potential is enormous, and we have the plan to make it real. Come join us.

There’s much more work to be done and we are looking for exceptional talent to join us on this extraordinary journey!

description:

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. 📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

⭐️ Our Ops Labs Team

We’re building Ops Labs: a small, high-impact team focused on incubating, testing and scaling new ideas that improve customer experience and create enterprise value for Monzo .

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, data and experimentation. You’ll take ideas from concept to reality - rapidly testing hypotheses, learning what works (and what doesn’t), and turning the best ideas into scalable solutions across Operations.

Many of these ideas will come from our strategy work, customer insight, and experience gaps. Your job is to turn them into tangible experiments, validate their impact, and help scale the ones that meaningfully improve customer outcomes, reduce cost, or unlock new value.

This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll need to be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, building structure where none exists, and working hands-on to bring ideas to life.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

•
Turning ideas into real-world experiments - Take ideas emerging from strategy, customer insights, and experience gaps, and translate them into testable hypotheses. Design and execute experiments end-to-end - from scoping and setup to execution, measurement and readout - with a strong bias to action and speed.

•
Incubating high-potential opportunities - Identify and develop early-stage ideas that could significantly improve customer experience, reduce operational demand, or create commercial value. This could include rethinking service models, testing new ways to deliver support, or exploring entirely new capabilities within Ops.

•
Scaling successful experiments into production - Work closely with product, engineering, data science and operations teams to take successful pilots and scale them. Ensure there is a clear path from experiment → validated impact → operational or product integration.

•
Advancing goodwill and customer experience innovation - Reimagine how we deliver goodwill and recover from poor experiences - testing new approaches that improve customer trust while being sustainable and scalable. Push beyond incremental fixes to meaningfully raise the bar for customer experience.

•
Creating strong feedback loops with data science and CX insights - Partner closely with Customer Experience, Data Science and Insights teams to ensure experiments are informed by real customer pain points, and that we rigorously track the impact of changes (e.g. what actually improves CSAT, reduces complaints, or drives engagement).

•
Measuring impact and building the case for change - Define clear success metrics for experiments (CSAT, demand reduction, cost, engagement, etc.), track outcomes, and communicate results clearly. Build compelling cases to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives based on evidence.

•
Working hands-on with frontline operations (COps) - Collaborate closely with COps to test ideas in real environments. Use their feedback and expertise to refine experiments and ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and grounded in reality.

•
Pave the way for building a bigger experimentation engine

•

• Demonstrated proficiency operating and querying Loki (LogQL) and Mimir / Prometheus (PromQL).

• Working experience with distributed tracing via Tempo (OpenTelemetry standards).

• Direct experience with modern telemetry collectors, specifically Grafana Alloy(or OpenTelemetry Collector / Promtail).

• Clear understanding of high cardinality, multi-tenancy, and object storage lifecycles for metrics and logs.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Typescript) - Full Stack
description:
The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks. At Augintel , we build Natural Language Processing (NLP) software that helps social workers and clinicians read through mountains of messy case notes to find critical, life-saving information about kids and families.

Our tool can help a social worker understand a thousand-page case history in seconds. Because of our software, caseworkers are finding lost grandmothers so kids don't go to foster care, uncovering hidden risks, and quickly spotting if a child urgently needs diabetes medication.
We are a small, tight-knit team of five, and we need a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the infrastructure that makes this all possible.

What You Will Actually Do Here: We need you to build the heavy-lifting software around the AI. You will be working closely with a Machine Learning expert.

•
The Heavy Lifting (70%): The biggest chunk of your work will be building the engine that extracts insights from notes and indexes them for downstream consumers (APIs, our web app). This will entail designing and building pipelines that process millions of case notes reliably and at scale. This backend work is heavily driven by Python .

•
The Infrastructure: You will be configuring and using AWS (specifically ECS, OpenSearch, Lambda, and S3) and writing solid SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

•
The Web App (30%): The remaining portion of your work will involve the front-end user interface and APIs, where you will use TypeScript (React and NodeJS).

Who You Are:

•
You have 5+ years of real-world experience. We are looking for someone who is solidly mid-level (your second or third real job). You aren't an entry-level beginner, but you also aren't looking to be a hands-off architect or on a fast track to management. You just want to write great code and improve your craft.

•
You are independent. We are a remote team. We need someone who can work on their couch, figure things out, and know when to raise their hand for help without flailing.

•
You like talking to people. You will occasionally jump on video calls directly with our clients to troubleshoot issues, stand up new features, or whiteboard solutions. We don't want someone who just wants to sit in a dark closet and write code.

•
You want ownership. You won't just be blindly pulling widgets off a backlog. You will collaborate daily with our ML researcher, product manager, and clients to frame problems and design actual solutions.

The Perks:

• 100% Remote (US-based). If you happen to be in the Chicago area, great-we have a local nexus here-but it is absolutely not required.

• Get hands-on experience working right alongside cutting-edge Machine Learning and NLP technology.

• Go to sleep every night knowing your code is actively keeping kids safe and giving social workers their time back.

If you are a solid Python, Typescript and AWS developer who wants to use your powers for good, we want to talk to you.

title: Senior Performance TA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Performance Test Engineer to join our customer's engineering team and take ownership of performance testing across a modern AWS-based microservices platform.
﻿﻿ Location: Remote ( Ukraine)
Contract: B2B, Full-time (160 hours/month)
Working Hours: 10:00-19:00
Methodology: Scrum
In this role, you will design and implement scalable performance testing strategies, establish performance benchmarks, and work closely with Platform Engineering, DevX, SDET, and product teams to ensure applications remain reliable, scalable, and production-ready. You'll play a key role in identifying bottlenecks, analyzing system behavior, and driving performance improvements across the platform.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop comprehensive performance test suites for microservices and shared platform components running on AWS.

• Define performance KPIs, baselines, and acceptance thresholds to support release readiness and platform reliability.

• Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with DevX, Platform Engineering, SDET, and product teams.

• Execute non-functional testing, including load, stress, spike, endurance, and scalability testing.

• Analyze application logs, metrics, and observability data to identify performance bottlenecks and system degradations.

• Establish and maintain performance baselines for both microservices and legacy applications to enable long-term benchmarking.

• Investigate production-like issues and customer-reported performance problems, performing root cause analysis across applications, APIs, databases, and infrastructure.

• Provide recommendations to optimize application architecture, APIs, databases, and infrastructure.

• Document testing results, trends, performance improvements, and recommendations for technical and business stakeholders.

Requirements

• 6+ years of hands-on experience in performance testing for cloud-native, microservices-based SaaS applications.

• Strong experience with performance testing tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, or JMeter .

• Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring platforms, including Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK Stack, or AWS CloudWatch .

• Solid knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, RDS, S3, ECS, and EKS .

• Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes .

• Proficiency in Python (or similar scripting languages) for automation, performance analysis, and tooling.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with experience in root cause analysis, statistical evaluation, forecasting, and trend analysis.

• Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams in remote-first environments.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Czech language skills are considered an advantage.

Team & Project

• Active product development.

• Agile Scrum environment.

• Reports directly to the Director of Quality Engineering .

• Collaborates with Platform Engineering, DevX, SDET, and three parallel Quality Engineering streams:

• Data QA

• AI QA

• TA QA

title: SOC Security Analyst L2
description:
Position: SOC Security Analyst L2
Reports To: SOC Team Lead / SOC Manager
Department: Security Operations Center (SOC)
Location: Remote, Romania
Shift Schedule: 4-on / 4-off, rotating every 28 days between Early (9:00 AM-7:00 PM), Middle (2:00 PM-12:00 AM) and Night (11:00 PM-9:00 AM), Romania time
Work Authorization: Must be resident in, and legally authorized to work in, Romania

BlueVoyant is seeking a SOC Security Analyst L2 to join our Security Operations Center, defending our global customers against constant and evolving adversary activity. In this role you will own and work through a queue of security alerts and tickets, carrying out thorough investigations, resolving cases accurately and efficiently, and escalating confirmed or complex incidents to L3 analysts with clear, well-documented findings. You will work closely with senior analysts and clients to reduce the impact and dwell time of security incidents. This role reports into BlueVoyant SOC leadership and operates under BlueVoyant processes, tooling, and supervision at all times, including when working within client environments.

What You'll Do:

• Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and tickets from multiple sources, including SIEM logs, endpoint logs, and EDR telemetry.

• Own assigned tickets through to resolution, working within defined SLAs and prioritizing by severity and client impact.

• Research indicators and activities to determine reputation and suspicious attributes.

• Perform analysis of suspicious files, emails, URLs, and attacker infrastructure to support investigations.

• Determine whether activity is malicious, benign, or a false positive, and escalate confirmed or complex incidents to L3 analysts with clear supporting evidence.

• Document investigation steps, findings, and recommended actions accurately within the ticketing and case management system.

• Take initial response actions in line with runbooks and client-approved procedures, such as isolating endpoints or disabling compromised accounts.

• Communicate with clients to provide ticket updates, request information, and share remediation guidance.

• Identify false-positive or benign detections and recommend tuning improvements.

• Contribute to the improvement of runbooks, procedures, and automation.

• Support and share knowledge with L1 analysts and incorporate feedback from L3 peer review and QA.

• Operate across BlueVoyant -managed systems and client-provided environments in accordance with client-approved access controls, logging, and BlueVoyant operating procedures, maintaining strict separation and adherence to security policies.

What You'll Bring

• Ability to manage a high-volume ticket queue in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly and explain technical issues in easy-to-understand language.

• Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, including working effectively within a globally distributed team.

• Ability to work directly with clients to provide updates and gather information.

• Knowledge and experience with SIEM solutions, Cloud App Security tools, and EDR.

• Experience in endpoint, web, email, and authentication log analysis.

• Solid understanding of network protocols and network telemetry.

• Knowledge of common attack techniques, including phishing, business email compromise (BEC), credential harvesting, LOLBin use, and lateral movement.

• Working knowledge of:

• SIEM workflows (preferably Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk)

• Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security alerts and sign-in logs

• Email security and phishing analysis

• Network monitoring metadata (web logs, firewall logs, WAF/IDS)

• Windows and Unix operating system fundamentals and common forensic artifacts

• Ticketing and case management systems

• Ability to successfully complete a background check and any client-required security vetting.
